plans.text: Start working on an abstract piece using a bold and bright palette, with bright yellow as a possible dominant color, complementary colors for contrast, and layering and texture for depth and visual interest.
Set up a small art studio in the spare bedroom.

Set up the small art studio by purging and decluttering the space, assessing needs, optimizing the layout, investing in multi-functional furniture, using vertical space to maximize storage, creating a wet zone, and adding a comfortable seating area.
